positions.name: Energy Select Sector SPDR Fund
positions.catalyst: Thursday pre-market risk-off: Pentagon reportedly preparing potential strikes on Iran (Polymarket ~52%), Brent ~$104 with Tehran saying Hormuz won't reopen under pressure; 10Y ~5.35%. SPY -0.57%, QQQ -0.8%, SOXL -6.5% pre; USO +4.0%, XLE +1.5%, XOM +1.7%, GLD +0.2%.
positions.driver: Energy equities are the one sector with a positive fresh catalyst and the asymmetric skew: a strike spikes crude further, while XLE (+1.5% pre) has lagged crude (+4%) so it isn't chased. 1x matches medium conviction on a binary geopolitical headline. Beat USO/UCO (already +4%/+4.5% pre, gap-chase and violent reversal on any de-escalation), SOXS (+6.4% pre, chasing a 3x inverse into a strong semi uptrend), GLD (+0.2%, low upside), SPY/cash (negative tape).
positions.risks: De-escalation / diplomatic headline or SPR release knocks crude $5-10 lower; broad equity selloff drags XLE with market beta. Hard stop 60.44 (-6%).
